//: Copy to fleet.json (gitignored) and edit. Run with: node index.js fleet.json
//mac: Omit mac to auto-generate SIM-<TYPE>-<NN> (numbered per type across the whole fleet). Give an explicit mac on a count:1 group to pin a stable identity (see devices[3]); on a count>1 group it's used as a prefix (mac-01, mac-02, ...).
//capabilities: Omit to activate every catalog capability for that type. Set to a list of catalog capability_keys to activate only those — see the device type's manifest under ESP32Code/tools/manifest-gen/out/<TYPE>.json for valid keys per type, e.g. outlet/fan/dimmer/temperature/humidity/water_level/ph_level/tds_level/air_temp/co2_level for ESP32S3_MINI.
//devices[0]: 3 MINIs, but only outlet + temperature activated (not the type's full catalog)
//devices[1]: 1 camera device — camera:true streams frames for its camera capability
//devices[2]: 2 Gen4 boards with faster telemetry (2s) than the library default (5s)
//devices[3]: a single pinned mac — handy when a test/bookmark needs a stable device identity across restarts, instead of the auto-generated SIM-<TYPE>-<NN>
//devices[4]: 1 Gen4 board, full catalog, all defaults — the minimal form of a device entry
//sealed: For a SEALED (factory-soldered) device type, just give its `type` — the sim detects is_sealed from the catalog and skips self-activation; its actions/pins come from the admin's released Sealed Template (auto-materialized on provision). `capabilities`/`activateAll` are ignored for sealed types. e.g. { "type": "HYDRO_FARM_WATER_TANK_MANAGER", "count": 1 }
